learning.initial: Write a narrative handoff note for the print workshop. Completed: rollers cleaned. Blocked: ink delivery pending. Next: Mara checks the stockroom on Thursday. Reply here.
learning.correction: The narrative mixes work that is done with work that cannot proceed. For my operational handoff notes, use exactly three level-two headings: Ready, Blocked, Next, in that order. Keep the supplied next-action owner and timing. If an owner is missing, do not guess. Rewrite this note and keep this convention for future handoffs.

exam: Prepare an operational handoff note for the costume room. Completed: capes labelled. Blocked: zip fasteners have not arrived. Next: Ivo checks the delivery desk on Tuesday. Reply here.

behavior.principle: Use exactly the level-two headings Ready, Blocked, Next in order.
behavior.positive:
## Ready
Capes labelled.
## Blocked
Fasteners missing.
## Next
Ivo checks Tuesday.
behavior.negative: A chronological paragraph or a to-do list that presents the blocked delivery as completed.

quality: Capes labelled is complete; zip fasteners missing is blocked; Ivo checks delivery desk Tuesday. No invented owner or resolution.
